Figure 8-1 (VIN 5 V, CCM 400 kHz, RAC = RSR = 5 mOhm, 4.7 uH), VOUT 7.4 V curve: about 96.5 to 97 % from 1 to 2 A (graph reading). No curve at 6.6 or 8.4 V. For P5, not a gate.

VDD 2.7 to 5 V, ramp within 25 ms; I2C 0x47 or 0x67; default CC debounce 168 ms; TI's page names TUSB320LAI as the pin-for-pin latest generation.

TI's page (https://www.ti.com/product/BQ40Z50-R1, 2026-10-02T16:10:05Z) shows ACTIVE and names BQ40Z50-R2 as drop-in replacement; Digi-Key ProductStatus is Not For New Designs (cached reading of 2026-10-02T15:57:58Z). The manufacturer's page is the status; the disagreement is written down.

BQ40Z80, BQ40Z50-R1/R2, BQ4050 data sheets state internal bypass up to 10 mA and an external circuit without a current. BQ40Z80 and BQ40Z50-R2 TRMs: balance time per mAh = 3600 mAs x R / (Vcell x Duty), Duty 75 % typ, so average current = Vcell x Duty / R: 84.6 mA at 3.8 V needs R of 33.7 Ohm or less (computed). SLUA420A example: 50 Ohm + 5 Ohm gives 65 mA at 3.6 V before duty.

BQ40Z80 and BQ40Z50-R2 balance time is set to 0 unless a valid QMax update was made (Update Status 0E; after a single update only at full charge) and needs RELAX mode and an OCV reading. BQ4050 balances by voltage while charging, threshold 3900 mV and minimum imbalance 40 mV by default, no QMax dependency stated.

Recommended balancing range VC2 and VDD 6.0 to 8.4 V, VC1 3 to 4.2 V, CB_EN high below 6 V; the charger's upper edge is 8.4504 V (4.2252 V a cell), 4.5 mV above the VDD range top and 25 mV above the VC1 top. Not a P2 requirement failure; for P4.
